tagline.en: The DUSt3R base-model profile — the underlying checkpoint that supplies feed-forward 3D reconstruction as a geometry prior.
tagline.zh: DUSt3R 基础模型配置——为几何先验提供前馈式 3D 重建的底层 checkpoint。

en: This is the base-model profile behind the DUSt3R entry: the underlying network and checkpoint that produce feed-forward 3D reconstruction from images. DUSt3R, from NAVER LABS Europe, predicts dense 3D geometry from a small set of uncalibrated views in a single pass.

It shares the same in-tree source as the main DUSt3R catalog entry, so both draw on one implementation. Rather than being a standalone app, it is the reusable geometry component — from two views it can produce a dense point-cloud reconstruction.
In WorldFoundry it is exposed through the shared geometry-prior pipeline as a source of 3D structure for downstream 3D and 4D stages, rather than as an end-to-end pipeline runner of its own.
zh: 这是 DUSt3R 条目背后的基础模型配置:即从图像产出前馈式 3D 重建的底层网络与 checkpoint。DUSt3R 来自 NAVER LABS Europe,能在一次推理中从少量未标定视角预测稠密 3D 几何。
它与主 DUSt3R 目录条目共享同一份内置源码,因此二者基于同一实现。它并非独立应用,而是可复用的几何组件——从两个视角即可产出稠密点云重建。
在 WorldFoundry 中,它通过共享的 geometry-prior pipeline 对外提供,作为下游 3D、4D 环节的三维结构来源,而非自身独立的端到端 pipeline 运行器。

whenToUse.en: This profile is what you reference when you need DUSt3R's reconstruction as a geometry prior inside a larger 3D/4D workflow, rather than running it as a standalone tool.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要在更大的 3D/4D 工作流中把 DUSt3R 的重建作为几何先验来引用,而非作为独立工具运行时,就使用这个配置。

notFor.en: It's a base-model profile, not a standalone pipeline runner — use the main DUSt3R route for a runnable path. The same non-commercial DUSt3R licensing applies.
notFor.zh: 它是基础模型配置,而非独立的 pipeline 运行器——要可运行的路径请使用主 DUSt3R 入口。同样适用 DUSt3R 的非商用许可。

en: Base-model profile behind the DUSt3R entry
Feed-forward 3D reconstruction from a few views
Surfaced as a geometry prior for 3D/4D stages
zh: DUSt3R 条目背后的基础模型配置
从少量视角前馈式重建 3D
以几何先验形式服务于 3D/4D 环节
